dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL with OcesSQL (Open COBOL ESQL) for PostgreSQL connectivity; uses *> comment style, EXEC SQL with PostgreSQL-specific connection string format 'postgres@db:5432'
evidence: EXEC SQL CONNECT :USERNAME IDENTIFIED BY :PASSWD USING :DBNAME

purpose.domain_detail: Demonstration report generator reading from a PostgreSQL database table and writing a formatted text report file
purpose.summary: DEMO-REPORT reads records from a PostgreSQL database table (demo_table) for the current date and writes a formatted text report to a file. It supports command-line arguments to switch between live and test database connections, and includes built-in unit and integration test workflows.

notable_features: EXEC SQL (OcesSQL/PostgreSQL): CONNECT, DECLARE CURSOR, OPEN, FETCH, INSERT, DELETE, DISCONNECT
Command-line argument parsing via ACCEPT FROM COMMAND-LINE
Built-in unit and integration test framework with pass/fail counters
SQLCA included via EXEC SQL INCLUDE
No COPY statements or CALL statements
PERFORM UNTIL loop with cursor fetch pattern
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clear. The program is a well-structured demo/example with embedded test harness. OcesSQL is an open-source ESQL preprocessor for GnuCOBOL targeting PostgreSQL. No COMP-3 usage, consistent with GnuCOBOL/open-source style. The filename 'demo_report.cbl' and PROGRAM-ID 'DEMO-REPORT' confirm demo/example nature.
